description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location in Langley, BC, offering the full range of espresso drinks, cold refreshers, and grab-and-go food items. With outdoor seating and free Wi-Fi, it serves as a comfortable mid-ride rest stop in the city. As a corporate chain location, cyclists can expect consistent service and indoor facilities.
